title: Canal and Drainage Extension to Rohri Canal Area Act 1991

sections.shortTitle: Canal and Drainage Extension to Rohri Canal Area Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1991
ACT I OF 1991
CANAL AND DRAINAGE (EXTENSION TO ROHRI CANAL AREA) ACT, 1991
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(I) This Act may be
called the Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from the 23rd October, 1990.

sections.shortTitle: Canal and Drainage Extension to Rohri Canal Area Act 1991
sections.description:
Extension of Act VIII of 1873 to Rohri canal areas

ACT I OF 1991
ACT I OF 1991
CANAL AND DRAINAGE (EXTENSION TO ROHRI CANAL AREA) ACT, 1991
2. Extension of Act VIII of
1873 to Rohri Canal Areas: ‑As from the commencement of this Act, the
Canal and Drainage Act, 1873, shall apply to the areas irrigated by the Rohri
Canal in Tando Adam Taluka District Sanghar.

sections.shortTitle: Canal and Drainage Extension to Rohri Canal Area Act 1991
sections.description:
Sindh Act VII of 1879 not to apply

ACT I OF 1991
ACT I OF 1991
CANAL AND DRAINAGE (EXTENSION TO ROHRI CANAL AREA) ACT, 1991
3. Sindh Act VII of 1879 not to
apply.‑‑So long as this Act is in force, the Sindh Irrigation Act,
1879,. shall not be applicable to the areas to which the Canal j and Drainage Act,
1873 applies.
